resources.string: Optional. Bring your Ravelry stash, needles, projects, and library patterns into Stitchbook. On Ravelry, open Pro → Developer, create an app, and add a \"Basic Auth: personal account access\" key. Type it here: it stays encrypted on this phone, and Stitchbook only reads from Ravelry, never writes.
A Ravelry key is saved on this phone.
Check Ravelry to see what\'s new before anything is saved. Nothing here is ever deleted, and nothing is sent to Ravelry.
Ravelry didn\'t accept this key. Check it\'s a personal account access key (read-only keys can\'t see your stash), or forget it and type it again.
Couldn\'t reach Ravelry. Check your connection and try again; nothing was changed.
Something went wrong saving to this phone. Check Ravelry again: anything already saved is recognised, and the rest is offered again.
Everything from Ravelry is already here.
Updating changed items replaces only Ravelry\'s details. Your notes, purchase details, weighed remainders, project types, and attached PDFs stay as they are.
This PDF has no direct download identifier. Download it from your Ravelry library in a browser, then attach it here.
Ravelry refused the app\'s PDF request. Download it in your signed-in browser, then use Attach PDF here.
Ravelry is limiting requests. Wait before trying again; PDF download links have a daily limit.
Ravelry is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
The PDF link has expired or is unavailable. Try again to request a fresh link.
Couldn\'t attach this PDF. Choose it again and allow access.
